001: Ivan, good morning! Are you ready for your first day at work?
Good morning, Anna! I'm a little nervous, but everything will be fine.
Don't worry, I'll show you the office and introduce you to your colleagues.
Thank you, that helps a lot. And where is my workspace?
Your desk is over there, by the window. Do you like it?
Yes, it's a great spot. The view is just wonderful.
002: Sergey, this is our new employee, Alexey.
Nice to meet you, Alexey. I've heard about you from the boss.
Nice to meet you too. I've heard a lot about your team.
I'm glad you joined us. If you need help, just ask.
Thank you, I will. And where can I get the documents to review?
I'll bring them all to you right now, just wait a couple of minutes.
003: Dmitry, have you already met our department?
Not yet, only you. And how many people are on our team?
There are eight of us, including the manager. Everyone is very friendly.
That's great. And when is our usual lunch break?
From one to two. We often go to the café across the street.
Great, then I'll go with you, if you don't mind.
004: Olga, can you tell me how the internal reporting program works?
Sure, I'll show you right now. It's really simple, you'll figure it out quickly.
I hope so. And is there a manual in Russian?
Yes, I'll send you the file by email. Everything is described in detail there.
Thank you so much. It's very kind of you to help me.
Don't mention it, we were all newcomers once.
005: Alexey, have you already gotten your pass and system access?
Yes, they gave me everything yesterday. And what else needs to be done?
You need to fill out a form in HR and sign the contract.
Okay, I'll take care of that after lunch. And who should I go to?
Go to Elena, she's the lead specialist. I'll let her know about you.
006: Maria, how was your first day at the new job?
Very good, but there was a lot of new information. I'm a little tired.
That's normal, it's always like that on the first day. The main thing is that you liked it.
Yes, the team is wonderful, and the work is interesting. I'm pleased.
I'm glad to hear that. If you have questions, I'm always here.
Thank you, Maria. You're very supportive of me.
007: Sergey, could you tell me where the meeting room is?
It's on the third floor, next to the director's office.
And how do I book it for a meeting?
In the booking system, I'll show you if you want.
Yes, I'd be very grateful. I have my first meeting with a client tomorrow.
Don't worry, everything will go well. You'll handle it.
008: Anna, I've finished all my tasks for today. What should I do next?
Already everything? You work very fast. You can look at the documents for the new project.
Okay, and where are they? In the shared folder?
Yes, in the "Project Alpha" folder. I sent you the access.
Thank you, I'll take a look now. If something is unclear, I'll ask.
009: Dmitry, do you know when payday is this month?
Usually on the twenty-fifth. Did they already tell you?
Yes, but I forgot the exact date. Thanks for reminding me.
No problem. And have you already opened a bank card for your salary?
Yes, I took care of everything last week.
Great, then there won't be any issues.
010: Olga, how's your first day? Settling in already?
Yes, everything's great. My colleagues helped a lot, I already understand a lot.
I'm very glad. And have you already had lunch with us?
Yes, we went to the café together. It was very nice.
Wonderful. Then tomorrow we'll continue getting acquainted with the projects.
Sounds good. Thank you for the warm welcome!
